Connecting

All Stakeholders

An Inclusive Solution from Development to the Field

Data Scientists

Build models and improve accuracy

Data scientists can use the Summary and Validation pages on the web UI and SDK to validate the performance of their models, investigate results, and address issues.

Data Science Managers and Chief Data Officers

Oversee team’s progress

Data science managers and Chief data officers can track the work of their teams, compare models, and ensure KPIs are being met.

Risk Officers, Model Risk Managers

Check model validity and assess risks

Risk officers and MRMs can use the web UI and reports to verify the soundness of the model, assess the risks, and ensure AI is being used responsibly and fairly according to regulatory requirements.

Executives and Regulators

Receive customized executive reports 

Executives and regulators can use summarized custom reports to verify the model's strength and accuracy, understand the model's decisions, identify risks, and ensure compliance to protect the organization from potential lawsuits and maintain their reputations.

Benefits of Citrusˣ

Proprietary
Technology

Citrusˣ’s patent-pending solution is a unique methodology that comprises multiple proprietary methods. What sets Citrusˣ apart is our ability to dive into local samples in real time.

Full transparency
at every level

Our commitment to transparency sets us apart as we offer a two-fold approach to explainability for your models. On a global and local level, we provide complete and comprehensive explainability.

Outperforms
benchmarks

How does Citrusˣ compare to other benchmarks? Citrusˣ outperforms international benchmarks such as SHAP and LIME in all performance metrics, which will save you time, costs, and resources.

Insight into biases and vulnerable segments

Uncover precisely where the biases and vulnerabilities are within your model. Citrusˣ empowers you to preempt and avoid discriminatory outcomes, ensuring your model is ethical and fair.

Automated real
time reports

Ultimately, the end goal is to see the results! Citrusˣ Reports simplify the management of multiple deployed models. Our real-time and customized reporting provides an in-depth analysis of model validation and model monitoring.

Comply with AI Regulations

Ensure seamless compliance with AI regulations (EU AI Act, AIDA) by by implementing mitigation measures to minimize risks and vulnerabilities. Citrusˣ delivers clear insights into your AI system’s functionality, limitations, and risks.
